_note: Sample crew. Salaries (millions USD for the whole mission) and skill levels are approximate game-balance placeholders. Portrait ids follow the convention crew-<id> and resolve to public/assets/portraits/<portrait>.webp.

items.name: Dr. Mina Okafor

strength.text: Spots patterns in instrument data that others miss.

weakness.text: Over-plans and delays decisions under time pressure.

items.backstory: Planetary geologist who spent three winters at an Antarctic ice-core station. Wants to be the first person to hold lunar ice.

items.name: Jonas Reyes

strength.text: Fixes hardware fast with whatever is on hand.

weakness.text: Cuts science time to protect power and life-support margins.

items.backstory: Former submarine electrician. Believes every system should survive two failures before anyone notices.

items.name: Priya Natarajan

strength.text: Keeps the team calm and talking during long signal delays.

weakness.text: Prefers the best hardware, even when it costs more.

items.backstory: Deep-space network engineer who once talked a probe through a safe-mode recovery with a 20-minute round-trip delay.

items.name: Theo Lindqvist

strength.text: Finds cheaper launch and procurement options.

weakness.text: Trims safety margins to stay under budget.

items.backstory: Launch-campaign manager who has never missed a window or a budget, and has the spreadsheets to prove it.
